suffer a loss: Because of the typhoon, many fruit farmers in the south will suffer a loss of nearly half their crops.
由於颱風，南部許多果農將蒙受將近一半作物的損失。
suffer from headaches: Students who stare at their phones late at night often suffer from headaches and feel tired in class.
深夜盯著手機的學生常為頭痛所苦，上課時也覺得疲倦。
suffer defeat: Our basketball team did not want to suffer defeat again, so they practiced every day before the final.
我們的籃球隊不想再遭受失敗，所以決賽前每天練習。
suffer the consequences: If you keep breaking the school rules, sooner or later you will suffer the consequences and be punished.
如果你一直違反校規，遲早會承擔後果而受到處罰。
suffer damage: Several old houses near the river began to suffer damage after a week of heavy rain and flooding.
連續一週豪雨淹水後，河邊幾棟老房子開始受損。
quality suffers: When a factory is pushed to work too fast, quality suffers and more customers start to complain.
當工廠被逼著趕工時，品質就會受影響，越來越多顧客開始抱怨。
suffer in silence: Many students who are bullied suffer in silence because they are afraid to tell their parents or teachers.
許多被霸凌的學生默默忍受，因為他們害怕告訴父母或老師。
suggest a solution: When the class could not agree on a trip, Amy stood up to suggest a solution that everyone liked.
當全班無法對旅行地點達成共識時，艾美站起來建議了一個大家都喜歡的解決方案。
the evidence suggests: The police believe that the evidence suggests the thief entered the store through a back window.
警方認為證據顯示小偷是從後窗進入店裡的。
suggest doing: My doctor would suggest doing some exercise every day instead of sitting in front of a computer for hours.
我的醫生會建議每天做些運動，而不是在電腦前坐好幾個小時。
suggest otherwise: He says he studied hard for the test, but his low grades seem to suggest otherwise.
他說他為考試很用功，但他的低分似乎顯示並非如此。
the name suggests: As the name suggests, the Rainbow Bridge shines in seven different colors when the lights come on at night.
正如名稱暗示的，彩虹橋在夜晚燈亮時會閃耀七種不同顏色。
suit one's needs: We looked at many apartments and finally found one that could suit our needs, close to school and quite cheap.
我們看了很多公寓，終於找到一間符合我們需求的，離學校近又很便宜。
suit yourself: "I'm not going to the party tonight." "Fine, suit yourself, but you'll miss all the fun."
「我今晚不去派對了。」「好啊，隨你便，但你會錯過所有樂趣。」
suit the occasion: Jeans and a T-shirt do not suit the occasion, so please wear something formal to the wedding.
牛仔褲和T恤不適合這個場合，所以請穿正式一點去參加婚禮。
suit one's purpose: The small notebook may look simple, but it can suit my purpose of writing down new words every day.
這本小筆記本看起來也許很簡單，但符合我每天記下新單字的目的。
the color suits you: You should buy that blue dress; the color suits you and makes your eyes look brighter.
你應該買那件藍色洋裝；這顏色很適合你，讓你的眼睛看起來更明亮。
suit someone down to the ground: The quiet job in the library would suit someone down to the ground who loves books and peace.
圖書館裡安靜的工作完全適合熱愛書本與寧靜的人。
sum up the situation: After listening to both sides, the teacher tried to sum up the situation in a few simple words.
聽完雙方說法後，老師試著用幾句簡單的話總結情況。
to sum up: To sum up, regular exercise, enough sleep, and healthy food are the keys to a long and happy life.
總而言之，規律運動、充足睡眠和健康飲食是長壽快樂生活的關鍵。
sum up a person: My grandmother can sum up a person in a few minutes just by watching how they treat waiters.
我奶奶只要觀察一個人怎麼對待服務生，幾分鐘內就能看透這個人。
sum up one's feelings: It was hard for Mia to sum up her feelings on graduation day because she was both happy and sad.
畢業那天米亞很難概括自己的感受，因為她既開心又難過。
in sum: In sum, the new park has brought more visitors, cleaner air, and more business to our small town.
總之，新公園為我們的小鎮帶來更多遊客、更乾淨的空氣和更多商機。
summon courage: Shy Tom had to summon courage for a whole week before he finally asked Lisa to the dance.
害羞的湯姆鼓起勇氣整整一週，才終於邀請麗莎去舞會。
summon help: When the old man fell on the street, a student used her phone to summon help from the nearest hospital.
老先生在街上跌倒時，一名學生用手機向最近的醫院召喚援助。
summon a meeting: After the fire in the science lab, the principal decided to summon a meeting of all the teachers.
科學實驗室失火後，校長決定召集全體老師開會。
summon the strength: After running for two hours, the tired runner had to summon the strength to finish the last kilometer.
跑了兩小時後，疲憊的跑者必須鼓足力氣跑完最後一公里。
be summoned to court: The young man who saw the car accident will be summoned to court to tell the judge what happened.
目擊那場車禍的年輕人將被傳喚出庭，向法官說明事發經過。
summon up memories: The smell of fresh bread can summon up memories of my grandmother's kitchen when I was a child.
新鮮麵包的香味能喚起我小時候奶奶廚房的回憶。
